examples: Sign out the laptop you left at the office from the phone you have with you.
how_to: Open the skills catalog while signed in. The signed in devices box lists every device, marks this one, and has a sign out button on each other one and one to sign out all other devices.
media_exempt: the panel needs a catalog account signed in on two devices; its screenshot is captured in the pre-release recapture, not per change
name: Catalog signed in devices
summary: see every device signed in to your catalog account and sign any of them out.
where: The skills catalog, SIGNED IN DEVICES, under the sign in box.
